Considering that the agent sold in the name of the principals (Exh. H); that paragraph 7 of his written authority limited sale to holders of contracts to sell from Ben Llamanzares and to those who had paid him (Exh. E); that the defendants aver they paid rent through Llamanzares's representative (Answer, ¶40) and produce no paper from Llamanzares, their only down-payment receipt being dated 6 January 2005 and issued by the agent's side (Exh. 5, p. 3); that the principals disowned the agent's power in 2005 and no principal ratified the sale (Exh. F); and that the limits were annotated on the title in 1996 and the defendant avers she checked the instrument (Exh. B; Answer, ¶44[h]), the Deed of Absolute Sale of 29 September 2016 is void (Art. 1898).
